entities.summary: Catholic Church, a political institution in Ecuador during García Moreno's Theocracy and the Liberal Revolution (1860–1875). Led to the emergence of García Moreno assassinated on Government Palace steps — August 6, 1875 and Ecuador consecrated to the Sacred Heart of Jesus.
